decisions.reason: Changing the letter's date format does not alter the existing PE stamp or signature requirements.
The formatting correction affects the concurrence document, not the required engineering review, its subject, extent, baseline, purpose, or supporting evidence.
The message is a specific formatting comment handled by the documentation Requirement, but it does not change the standing obligation to incorporate bounded client or city comments.
The date-format correction concerns the current concurrence letter and is unrelated to calculations for the separate additional permit project.
The date-format correction does not change the deliverable or deferred lifecycle of the separate additional-project permit drawings.
